tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Ref.name: Old session cleanup checks

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Rep.description: Checks production math such as hen-days, plus the money reports.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Sal.description: Checks how eggs are chosen for an order when it is confirmed.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Sch.name: Database documentation checks

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Sec.description: Checks that a person can turn off their own two-step sign-in.

tests/Cluckwork.Api.IntegrationTests/Sec.description: Checks that too many code guesses from one address are refused.
